bio.text: Diana Harshbarger represents Tennessee's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and serves on the Energy and Commerce Committee.
She was born in Bloomingdale, near Kingsport, attended East Tennessee State University, and earned a Doctor of Pharmacy degree from Mercer University College of Pharmacy.
She has been a licensed pharmacist and business owner for over three decades and lives in Kingsport with her husband, Robert.
